draft_text: Ferrule achieved a higher test AUROC than Arbor-GBT on most of the six datasets in the tabular suite.
revised_text: Ferrule achieved a higher test AUROC than Arbor-GBT on all six datasets in the tabular suite.
rationale: T1 shows Ferrule higher than Arbor-GBT on all six datasets (81.6>80.9, 88.3>87.1, 93.7>92.8, 76.4>75.6, 84.9>84.1, 90.2>89.0). "Most" is accurate but understates the evidence, which shows all six. No statistical tests reported, so no significance claim.
